name: Octopus Energy API
tagline: UK retail electricity and gas products, tariffs, and Agile half-hourly prices
description: Public REST API for Octopus Energy's UK retail energy products and tariffs. Exposes product catalogues, unit rates (including Agile half-hourly prices), electricity and gas meter point details, consumption history for account holders, and related account data. Public product and tariff endpoints need no auth; account, meter, and consumption endpoints use HTTP Basic Auth with an API key.

auth.details: Public product/tariff endpoints: no auth. Account, meter points, and consumption: HTTP Basic Auth with API key as username and empty password (or API key as password with empty username). API key from Octopus Energy account dashboard (Developer settings).

use_cases: list available UK electricity and gas products and tariffs
fetch Agile Octopus half-hourly unit rates for a region
get electricity or gas unit rates for a product and GSP group
look up meter point details by MPAN or MPRN
retrieve historical consumption for an authenticated account
compare fixed vs variable tariff product codes and availability
